findings.evidenceJa: 体勢を崩し
findings.governingReading: has had his stance broken
findings.explanation: A concrete loss of posture becomes a vague disadvantage.

findings.evidenceJa: 赤い男に庇われながら
findings.governingReading: while being shielded by the man in red
findings.explanation: Archer’s active protection of Rin is reduced to her location behind him.

findings.evidenceJa: 喉を鳴らす
findings.governingReading: force a sound from my throat
findings.explanation: Shirou’s failed or inarticulate attempt to speak becomes a successful call.

findings.evidenceJa: あいつに斬りかかる
findings.governingReading: let Saber slash at her
findings.explanation: The explicitly bladed attack on Rin becomes generic.

findings.evidenceJa: 軽い痛みが走った
findings.governingReading: a slight pain runs through me
findings.explanation: Command Spell expenditure changes from slight pain to sharp pain.

findings.evidenceJa: 左手の甲に刻まれた印
findings.governingReading: marks engraved on the back of my left hand
findings.explanation: The location and inscription of the Command Spells are reduced to an unspecified hand.

findings.evidenceJa: 銀の甲冑が石化したかのように停止する
findings.governingReading: the silver armor stops as though turned to stone
findings.explanation: The Command Spell’s absolute arrest becomes voluntary hesitation.

findings.evidenceJa: あいつさっきの
findings.governingReading: That man—he’s the one from before
findings.explanation: A missing boundary visibly mangles Shirou’s recognition.

findings.highlight: We should have been able to defeat Archer and his Master here
findings.evidenceJa: 今なら確実にアーチャーとそのマスターを倒せた
findings.governingReading: We could certainly have defeated Archer and his Master just now
findings.explanation: Saber’s claim of a certain lost opportunity becomes a weaker expectation.

findings.evidenceJa: 彼女を斬り殺してしまう
findings.governingReading: her cut the girl down and kill her
findings.explanation: Shirou’s horror at Rin being killed is softened into seeing Saber slash at her.

findings.highlight: the red man she could not slay
findings.evidenceJa: 倒し損なった赤い男
findings.governingReading: the man in red whom she failed to defeat
findings.explanation: A missed tactical defeat becomes an assertion that Saber was unable to kill Archer.

findings.evidenceJa: ここで仕留めておかなければ
findings.governingReading: we must finish her off here
findings.explanation: Saber’s lethal tactical demand is softened.

findings.evidenceJa: そんな事は知らない
findings.governingReading: I don’t know any of that
findings.explanation: Shirou’s admitted ignorance becomes indifference.

findings.evidenceJa: それはそうですが、しかし
findings.governingReading: That is true, but…
findings.explanation: mirror moon adds an explicit narration of Saber hesitating that is absent from the active source.

findings.highlight: the girl in her school uniform
findings.evidenceJa: それを押しのけて前に出る制服姿の少女
findings.governingReading: a uniformed girl pushing past him to step forward
findings.explanation: Rin physically taking the foreground from Archer is omitted.

findings.evidenceJa: ならそれを連れている遠坂も
findings.governingReading: Then, Tohsaka, who has brought him with her, must also be—
findings.explanation: A missing boundary visibly mangles Shirou’s interrupted inference.

findings.evidenceJa: とんでもなく極上の笑顔
findings.governingReading: an outrageously exquisite smile
findings.explanation: The calculated perfection and comic excess of Rin’s social smile are flattened.

findings.highlight: I can almost forget about all these strange events
findings.evidenceJa: 異常な出来事が嘘みたいな気がして
findings.governingReading: the abnormal events begin to feel as though they were unreal
findings.explanation: A destabilized sense of reality becomes simple forgetfulness.

findings.evidenceJa: また難儀な事を
findings.governingReading: What a troublesome thing to take on again
findings.explanation: Archer’s dry complaint becomes malformed English about difficulty.

findings.evidenceJa: それこそ幻のように消え去った
findings.governingReading: vanishes as though he were an illusion
findings.explanation: A figurative description of spirit-form disappearance is asserted as literality.

findings.highlight: I’ll tell you everything, even if you say you don’t want to know
findings.evidenceJa: イヤだって言っても全部教えてあげる
findings.governingReading: I’ll teach you everything even if you say no
findings.explanation: Rin’s refusal to accept any objection is narrowed to Shirou not wanting knowledge.

findings.evidenceJa: さっきの笑顔とは別物だった
findings.governingReading: was altogether different from the smile before
findings.explanation: The abrupt transformation in Rin’s expression is weakened.

findings.highlight: now is one of those times
findings.evidenceJa: 今がその時だって分かって
findings.governingReading: understand that this is precisely such a moment
findings.explanation: The immediate lethal threshold becomes merely one example among several.

findings.evidenceJa: １８０度イメージが違う
findings.governingReading: her image seems reversed by a full 180 degrees
findings.explanation: Shirou’s comic image of complete reversal is generalized.

findings.evidenceJa: 学校のアイドル
findings.governingReading: the school idol
findings.explanation: The English invents a numerical rank for Rin’s school status.

findings.highlight: transfer a part of their body into something and then summon it as another self
findings.evidenceJa: 魔術師の体の一部を移植され、分身として使役される
findings.governingReading: have part of a magus’s body transplanted into them and are employed as the magus’s double
findings.explanation: The direction and recipient of the transplant are blurred, and ongoing use as a double becomes summoning.

findings.highlight: magical energy to control someone like that
findings.evidenceJa: 相手を縛り付ける魔力
findings.governingReading: magical power capable of binding someone like her
findings.explanation: A concrete magical binding relation becomes generalized control.

findings.highlight: Magic Circuit to summon a familiar
findings.evidenceJa: 使い魔を使役するだけの魔術回路
findings.governingReading: enough Magic Circuits to employ a familiar
findings.explanation: Shirou’s deficiency in sustaining or controlling a familiar becomes inability to summon one; plural circuits become singular.

findings.highlight: must rather be something else than a familiar
findings.evidenceJa: 使い魔とは似て非なるモノ
findings.governingReading: must be something resembling a familiar but fundamentally different
findings.explanation: The technical inference is rendered in malformed, vague English.

findings.evidenceJa: 切嗣の代から
findings.governingReading: since Kiritsugu’s generation
findings.explanation: The named person locating the Emiya family’s arrival becomes a generic family relation.

findings.evidenceJa: 俺が魔術を習っている
findings.governingReading: I was studying magecraft
findings.explanation: An ongoing, limited course of instruction becomes possession of generic magic knowledge.

findings.highlight: I am not used to this Japanese style
findings.evidenceJa: 和風っていうのも新鮮だなぁ
findings.governingReading: The Japanese style feels fresh, too
findings.explanation: Rin’s appreciative sense of novelty becomes personal unfamiliarity.

findings.evidenceJa: ほんの少しだけまじまじと観察し
findings.governingReading: examines it closely for just a moment
findings.explanation: Rin’s brief but intent examination of the glass is flattened.

findings.evidenceJa: 数秒とかからず
findings.governingReading: in less than a few seconds
findings.explanation: The upper bound on the repair time becomes a looser duration.

findings.evidenceJa: まさかとは思うけど
findings.governingReading: I doubt it, but let me make sure
findings.explanation: Rin’s incredulous preface becomes an assertion that her own question is impossible.

findings.highlight: She’s so beautiful usually, so this makes her look
findings.evidenceJa: なまじ美人なだけに黙り込むと
findings.governingReading: Precisely because she is so beautiful, her silence makes her
findings.explanation: The causal force of Rin’s beauty intensifying her silent pressure becomes a contrast with how she usually looks.

findings.evidenceJa: なんとも半端なのを使う
findings.governingReading: what a half-baked discipline to specialize in
findings.explanation: Rin criticizes Strengthening as an incomplete or middling specialization, not as intrinsically strange magic.

findings.highlight: I don’t think it matters right now
findings.evidenceJa: それとこれとは話が別だ
findings.governingReading: that is a separate issue
findings.explanation: Shirou’s principled distinction between his effort and his immaturity becomes temporary irrelevance.

findings.highlight: There’s no spell needed to activate it
findings.evidenceJa: 発動に呪文は必要なくて
findings.governingReading: No incantation is required to activate it
findings.explanation: The verbal incantation requirement is confused with a spell, even though the Command Spell itself has just been defined as a spell.

findings.evidenceJa: マスターが他のマスターを倒す
findings.governingReading: Masters defeating other Masters
findings.explanation: The general rule is made categorically lethal before the subsequent explanation supplies the killing contest.

findings.evidenceJa: 望みを叶える聖杯が与えられる
findings.governingReading: is granted the Holy Grail that will fulfill their wish
findings.explanation: The stated reward loses the essential reason it is desired.

findings.highlight: until you kill all other Masters
findings.evidenceJa: 他のマスターを一人残らず倒すまで
findings.governingReading: until every other Master has been defeated
findings.explanation: A victory condition framed as defeating opponents is made categorically homicidal.

findings.evidenceJa: あまりにも潔かった誰かの声
findings.governingReading: someone’s astonishingly decisive, forthright voice
findings.explanation: The defining quality of Rin’s unseen intervention is misread as moral or tonal purity.

findings.evidenceJa: 覚悟ぐらいちゃんと知ってる
findings.governingReading: I know perfectly well what resolve means
findings.explanation: Shirou’s knowledge of the demanded resolve becomes a claim that he has already accepted the war.

findings.evidenceJa: 俺はあの時、誰かに
findings.governingReading: Back then, someone—
findings.explanation: The unfinished attempt to mention his unknown rescuer is replaced by a malformed fragment with different content.

findings.highlight: You’re one of the seven Masters of the Holy Grail War
findings.evidenceJa: 聖杯戦争の主役なんだから
findings.governingReading: you are one of the seven Masters, one of the principal actors in the Holy Grail War
findings.explanation: Rin’s framing of Shirou as a central participant rather than an observer disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 己が手足であるサーヴァントを行使して
findings.governingReading: wields the Servant who serves as their own hands and feet
findings.explanation: The functional and hierarchical metaphor defining Master–Servant action is omitted.

findings.evidenceJa: 他のマスターを潰していく
findings.governingReading: eliminate/crush the other Masters
findings.explanation: A broad aggressive defeat verb becomes explicitly homicidal.

findings.highlight: too brief for me to understand
findings.evidenceJa: 実感を得るには遠すぎた
findings.governingReading: far too remote for it to feel real
findings.explanation: Shirou’s inability to internalize the explanation becomes inability to comprehend it.

findings.evidenceJa: セイバーを盗み見る
findings.governingReading: I steal a glance at Saber
findings.explanation: Shirou’s self-conscious furtiveness toward Saber disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 死亡した伝説上の英雄
findings.governingReading: a legendary hero who has died
findings.explanation: The basic qualification that the summoned hero is dead is omitted.

findings.highlight: the Holy Grail does the rest
findings.evidenceJa: あとの実体化は聖杯がしてくれる
findings.governingReading: the Holy Grail handles their subsequent materialization
findings.explanation: The precise division of labor between Master summoning and Grail materialization becomes vague.

findings.highlight: recreate a soul and give it a body
findings.evidenceJa: 魂を再現して固定化する
findings.governingReading: reproduce a soul and fix it in place
findings.explanation: Fixing or stabilizing a reproduced soul is conflated with giving it a body.

findings.evidenceJa: 偉大な功績を残すと
findings.governingReading: leave behind a great achievement
findings.explanation: The English’s “any” loosens the threshold in Rin’s generalization.

findings.evidenceJa: 擬似的な神さま
findings.governingReading: quasi-gods
findings.explanation: A status resembling divinity through worship becomes deliberately manufactured divinity.

findings.evidenceJa: 降霊術とか口寄せとか
findings.governingReading: spirit invocation and mediumistic summoning
findings.explanation: Two examples of ordinary spirit-handling arts are collapsed into an invented quoted category and a misleading gloss.

findings.highlight: uses heroic spirits to make miracles happen
findings.evidenceJa: 英霊の力の一部を借り受けて奇蹟を起こす
findings.governingReading: borrow part of a Heroic Spirit’s power to work miracles
findings.explanation: The key contrast—ordinary arts borrow only part of the Heroic Spirit’s power—is removed.

findings.highlight: familiars made from the heroic spirits themselves
findings.evidenceJa: 英霊本体を直接連れてきて使い魔にする
findings.governingReading: bring the Heroic Spirit itself here directly and make it a familiar
findings.explanation: Directly importing the original spiritual being becomes constructing a familiar from it.

findings.highlight: give them form to make them fight
findings.evidenceJa: 実体化させて戦わせられる
findings.governingReading: materialize them and have them fight
findings.explanation: A defined spirit/material state transition becomes generic form-giving.

findings.evidenceJa: こっちの攻撃も当たる
findings.governingReading: attacks from our side can connect too
findings.explanation: A conditional statement about physical attacks landing becomes a claim that Rin and Shirou can attack effectively.

findings.evidenceJa: 言葉の上でなら
findings.governingReading: In words, yes
findings.explanation: Shirou’s distinction between verbal comprehension and acceptance becomes a vague technical qualification.

findings.evidenceJa: そんな悪趣味な事
findings.governingReading: something in such appalling taste
findings.explanation: Shirou’s explicit moral and aesthetic condemnation of the war disappears.

findings.highlight: all you can do now is fight
findings.evidenceJa: もう戦うしかなくて
findings.governingReading: you have no choice left but to fight
findings.explanation: Rin’s statement that alternatives are exhausted becomes a looser description of available action.

findings.evidenceJa: うまく使えって事
findings.governingReading: you are to make effective use of yours
findings.explanation: Rin’s blunt imperative about treating the Servant as a powerful familiar is softened into advice.
